create_kolors_pipeline_output: create a KolorsPipelineOutput dataclass instance with a list of PIL images or numpy array of denoised images
return_kolors_pipeline_output: return a KolorsPipelineOutput containing denoised PIL images or numpy array from a Kolors diffusion pipeline
access_kolors_images_field: access the images field of a KolorsPipelineOutput which holds denoised PIL images or numpy array
parse_kolors_pipeline_output: parse a KolorsPipelineOutput to extract denoised images as PIL.Image objects or numpy array for downstream use
extend_kolors_pipeline_output: extend KolorsPipelineOutput dataclass to add additional pipeline output fields beyond images
